scope: 87 public/large/centerpiece ImageGen references; reference approval is not model approval

regionalVisualReview.classic: French limestone, slate roofs and sage accents; civic/shop functions distinct; large families rise from low halls to corner towers or domes.
regionalVisualReview.compact: Kyoto timber, ivory plaster and blue gray tiles; restrained wood details; large families rise through added wings, upper balconies and lookout pavilions.
regionalVisualReview.expansion: New York red brick, cream vertical limestone and verdigris Art Deco crowns; larger levels add setbacks/towers; skyscraper_2 revised to match all crown heights.
regionalVisualReview.harbor: Mediterranean pale stone and blue ceramic roofs with arches; large levels add arcades, corner towers and domes; builders_guild revised to show correct back gable.
regionalVisualReview.alpine: Swiss honey timber, cream plaster, gray stone and terracotta roofs; large levels add upper gables, central towers or taller spa halls.
